spec_match.rationale: Checks for native support of Uint8Array.prototype.toBase64 and toggles status messages and warning labels.

interactive.rationale: Enables users to input custom texts, copy encoded hex or base64 strings, and round-trip decode pasted byte sequences.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Forms part of a rich, 4-part educational library on the TC39 proposal.

edge_cases.rationale: Includes a robust native-matching fallback polyfill so encode/decode remains fully operational on legacy clients.

references.rationale: The `see also` section links to https://chromestatus.com/feature/6281131254874112 directly.

design_system.rationale: Follows theme guidelines accurately with very clean layout structures.
